terms.definitionEn: A declaration that names the required shape of an object or callable value.
terms.definitionAr: تعريف بيسمي شكل الخصائص المطلوبة في object أو قيمة قابلة للاستدعاء.

terms.definitionEn: A named reference to a type expression, including unions, primitives, and object shapes.
terms.definitionAr: اسم بيرجع لتعبير نوع، وممكن يكون union أو primitive أو شكل object.

terms.definitionEn: An object member that may be omitted, marked with a question mark after its name.
terms.definitionAr: عضو في object ينفع يتساب، وبيتحدد بعلامة استفهام بعد اسمه.

terms.definitionEn: An object member that cannot be reassigned through that typed reference after initialization.
terms.definitionAr: عضو في object ماينفعش يتغير بالإسناد من خلال المرجع اللي نوعه محدد بعد التهيئة.

terms.definitionEn: A clause that builds a declaration from another compatible declaration while adding members.
terms.definitionAr: جزء بيبني تعريف على تعريف متوافق وبيضيف له أعضاء.
terms.example: interface Admin extends User { role: string }

terms.definitionEn: A type formed by combining requirements from multiple types with an ampersand.
terms.definitionAr: نوع بيجمع المتطلبات من أكتر من نوع باستخدام علامة &.

terms.definitionEn: An additional check that can flag unexpected members on a fresh object literal assigned to a target type.
terms.definitionAr: فحص إضافي ممكن يرفض أعضاء غير متوقعة في object literal جديد بيتسند لنوع محدد.
terms.example:
interface Size { width: number }
const size: Size = { width: 2, color: 'red' };

terms.definitionEn: The compiler behavior that combines compatible declarations sharing certain names, including interfaces.
terms.definitionAr: سلوك للـ compiler بيجمع تعريفات متوافقة بنفس الاسم في حالات معينة، ومنها interfaces.
terms.example:
interface Box { width: number }
interface Box { height: number }

terms.definitionEn: A member declaration describing the type of values accessed through keys of a specified kind.
terms.definitionAr: تعريف عضو بيوضح نوع القيم اللي بنوصل لها بمفاتيح من نوع محدد.

terms.definitionEn: A compatibility model based primarily on whether required members have compatible shapes.
terms.definitionAr: نظام توافق بيعتمد أساسًا على توافق شكل الأعضاء المطلوبة.
terms.example: const point: { x: number } = { x: 1, y: 2 };

terms.definitionEn: A type describing a collection of named properties and their compatible value types.
terms.definitionAr: نوع بيوصف مجموعة خصائص مسماة وأنواع القيم المتوافقة معاها.
terms.example: type Point = { x: number; y: number };

terms.definitionEn: The practice of constructing a new type from existing types through extension or combination.
terms.definitionAr: طريقة لبناء نوع جديد من أنواع موجودة باستخدام التوسيع أو الدمج.

questions.code:
interface Book { title: string; pages: number }
const item: Book = { title: 'Types', pages: 120 };
questions.question: What does the interface describe?
options: An object contract requiring textual title and numeric pages properties
A runtime class that constructs every book instance when its constructor is called
A tuple type requiring exactly two values to appear in a fixed positional order
A function type accepting a title argument and returning a newly created book object
questions.explanation: The declaration specifies the required property names and their types.
questions.explanationAr: التعريف بيحدد أسماء الخصائص المطلوبة وأنواعها.

questions.code: type UserId = string | number;
questions.question: Which values are accepted by UserId?
options: Only strings with numeric characters
Strings or numbers
Only arrays of strings and numbers
Any object with an id property
questions.explanation: The union expression allows either member type.
questions.explanationAr: تعبير الـ union بيسمح بأي نوع من النوعين.

questions.code:
interface Config { mode?: string }
const config: Config = {};
questions.question: Why is the empty object valid here?
options: All interface members are ignored during checking
The compiler inserts an empty string for mode
The question mark makes mode optional
An omitted property is treated as readonly
questions.explanation: The optional marker permits an object to omit that property.
questions.explanationAr: علامة الاختيارية بتسمح للـ object إنه مايحطش الخاصية دي.

questions.question: What does the compiler report for the final line?
options: No error because let makes every nested and top-level property mutable
No error because a string property may always be replaced with another string
A type error because the required code member is actually optional
A type error because code cannot be reassigned through this typed reference
questions.explanation: readonly prevents assignment to the property after the object is created through this typed reference.
questions.explanationAr: readonly بيمنع إعادة إسناد الخاصية من خلال المرجع ده بعد إنشاء الـ object.

questions.code:
interface Animal { name: string }
interface Dog extends Animal { bark(): void }
questions.question: What members must a Dog value provide?
options: Neither member because extends is runtime-only
Only bark because it replaces the parent shape
Only name because methods cannot be inherited
Both name and bark
questions.explanation: The extending interface includes inherited members and adds its own requirements.
questions.explanationAr: الـ interface الممتد بيشمل الأعضاء الموروثة وبيضيف متطلباته.

questions.code: type Contact = { email: string } & { phone: string };
questions.question: What shape satisfies Contact?
options: An object with either email or phone, but not necessarily both properties
An object containing both email and phone as required string members
A tuple with email first and phone second as ordered positional values
A function accepting both values and returning one combined contact record
questions.explanation: An intersection requires values to satisfy both object types.
questions.explanationAr: الـ intersection بيطلب إن القيمة تحقق النوعين مع بعض.

questions.code:
interface Bag { [key: string]: number }
const counts: Bag = { apples: 3 };
questions.question: What does the index signature require for string-keyed members?
options: Every key must be a numeric literal written directly in the declaration
All legal key names must be listed before any object is assigned
Values accessed through string keys must be compatible with number
Values may only be strings even though the signature says number
questions.explanation: The index signature describes the value type associated with string keys.
questions.explanationAr: الـ index signature بتحدد نوع القيم المرتبطة بمفاتيح نصية.

questions.code:
interface WindowState { open: boolean }
interface WindowState { title: string }
questions.question: What can compatible interface declarations with this name do?
options: The later declaration replaces all members from the earlier definition
They combine their members through declaration merging in one scope
They form a union where a value may satisfy only either definition
They cause a duplicate-identifier error in every TypeScript release
questions.explanation: Compatible interface declarations in the same scope can merge into one shape.
questions.explanationAr: تعريفات interface المتوافقة بنفس النطاق ممكن تندمج في شكل واحد.

questions.code:
type Code = string;
type Code = number;
questions.question: What does TypeScript report?
options: The second declaration replaces the first alias
The two aliases merge into string | number
No error because aliases can be repeated
A duplicate identifier error for the type alias
questions.explanation: Unlike interface declarations, a type alias name cannot be declared twice in the same scope.
questions.explanationAr: بعكس interface، اسم type alias ماينفعش يتعرف مرتين في نفس النطاق.

questions.code: type Handle = string | number;
questions.question: How many alternative member types does Handle contain?
options: One
Two
Three
Zero
questions.explanation: The union has one string member and one number member.
questions.explanationAr: الـ union فيه عضو string وعضو number.

questions.code:
interface Base { id: number }
interface Row extends Base { label: string }
questions.question: How many required properties does Row have?
options: One inherited property only
Three properties because extends duplicates id
Two properties: id and label
Zero, because interface members are optional
questions.explanation: Row includes the inherited id member and declares label.
questions.explanationAr: Row بيشمل id الموروث وبيضيف label.

questions.code: type A = { x: number } & { y: string };
questions.question: Which members are required by A?
questions.explanation: An intersection of these object types requires members from both sides.
questions.explanationAr: الـ intersection بين النوعين بيطلب الأعضاء من الناحيتين.

questions.prompt: Declare the object contract with a string name.
questions.code: ____ Person { name: string }
questions.explanation: interface introduces a named object shape declaration.
questions.explanationAr: interface بتبدأ تعريف شكل object باسم.

questions.prompt: Give this type expression a reusable name.
questions.code: ____ Point = { x: number; y: number };
questions.explanation: type declares a name for a type expression.
questions.explanationAr: type بتعرف اسم لتعبير نوع.

questions.prompt: Mark nickname as a property that may be absent.
questions.code: interface Profile { nickname____: string }
questions.explanation: The question mark after a property name makes it optional.
questions.explanationAr: علامة الاستفهام بعد اسم الخاصية بتخليها اختيارية.

questions.prompt: Prevent reassignment of the coordinate after initialization.
questions.code: interface Point { ____ x: number }
questions.explanation: readonly marks a property as non-reassignable through the typed reference.
questions.explanationAr: readonly بتمنع تغيير الخاصية من خلال المرجع المحدد النوع.

questions.prompt: Build Manager on top of Employee's members.
questions.code: interface Manager ____ Employee { teamSize: number }
questions.explanation: extends includes the base interface's members in the derived shape.
questions.explanationAr: extends بتضيف أعضاء الـ interface الأساسي للشكل الجديد.

questions.prompt: Require both named shapes in one type.
questions.code: type Account = User ____ { active: boolean };
questions.explanation: The ampersand combines requirements into an intersection type.
questions.explanationAr: علامة & بتجمع المتطلبات في intersection type.

questions.prompt: Describe arbitrary string keys whose values must be numeric.
questions.code: interface Metrics { [key: ____]: number }
questions.explanation: A string index signature applies the value type to string-keyed members.
questions.explanationAr: الـ index signature من نوع string بتحدد نوع قيمة الأعضاء ذات المفاتيح النصية.

questions.prompt: Combine the two existing object types into one requirement.
questions.code: type Complete = Person ____ Address;
questions.explanation: An intersection requires the resulting value to satisfy both constituent types.
questions.explanationAr: الـ intersection بيطلب إن القيمة تحقق النوعين المكونين.

questions.question: How do interfaces and type aliases differ, and when might you choose each?
keyPoints: Interfaces describe object-like contracts and can merge
Aliases can name unions and other type expressions
Both support describing compatible object shapes
questions.modelAnswer: Interfaces are a natural choice for object contracts and can be extended or declaration-merged. Type aliases can name unions, primitives, tuples, and composed expressions. Both can describe object shapes, so choose based on the desired composition and declaration behavior.
questions.explanation: The distinction matters most for composition and declaration merging, not basic object typing.
questions.explanationAr: الفرق الأهم بيظهر في تركيب الأنواع ودمج التعريفات، مش في وصف object عادي.

questions.question: What does readonly guarantee, and what does it not guarantee?
keyPoints: It prevents reassignment through a readonly reference
It does not deeply freeze nested objects at runtime
questions.modelAnswer: readonly prevents assignment to the marked property through that typed reference. It is a compile-time restriction and does not freeze the object at runtime. Nested objects can still be mutable unless their own types and runtime behavior prevent changes.
questions.explanation: A static readonly modifier is not a runtime deep-freeze operation.
questions.explanationAr: readonly قيد وقت الترجمة، مش تجميد عميق للـ object وقت التشغيل.

questions.question: When is interface extension clearer than an intersection?
keyPoints: Use extension to express a named base-to-derived relationship
The derived declaration can add or refine compatible members
The resulting contract is easier to read by name
questions.modelAnswer: Extension is clear when one named object contract is a specialized version of another. It keeps the base relationship visible and lets the derived declaration add members. Intersections are useful when combining independently defined requirements without presenting a hierarchy.
questions.explanation: The syntax can communicate whether composition is hierarchical or simply combined.
questions.explanationAr: الصياغة بتوضح إذا كان التركيب علاقة أساس وفرع ولا مجرد دمج متطلبات.

questions.question: Why can a fresh object literal receive an excess-property error while a variable with extra fields is accepted?
keyPoints: Fresh literals receive an additional typo-catching check
Structural compatibility focuses on required members
The check does not mean object types are exact or sealed
questions.modelAnswer: TypeScript performs an extra check on fresh object literals to catch likely misspelled property names. Assignability is otherwise largely structural, so a variable with the required compatible members can also have additional fields. This is not a general exact-object or sealed-type guarantee.
questions.explanation: Excess-property checking is an additional contextual check, not exact object typing.
questions.explanationAr: الفحص الإضافي للـ object literal مش معناه إن الأنواع بتمنع كل الخصائص الزايدة.
